instruction:
Use Abaqus/CAE via the Command Line Interface (CLI) to perform a modal analysis of a cantilever beam (Variant A). Use the N-mm-MPa unit system.

Part:
Create a 3D Deformable Solid part using Extrusion. Sketch a 12 mm x 10 mm rectangle in the Y-Z plane. Extrude along the global X-axis to a length of 420 mm. This creates a beam with cross-section 12 mm x 10 mm and length 420 mm.

Property:
Create a material named Steel. Set Young's modulus E = 210000 MPa, Poisson's ratio nu = 0.3, and density = 7.80e-9 tonne/mm^3.

Assembly:
Create one dependent instance of the beam.

Step:
Create a Linear Perturbation > Frequency step named Step-Modal-A. Request 4 eigenvalues.

Load:
Apply an Encastre boundary condition to the fixed end face at X = 0.

Mesh:
Apply a global seed size of 12 mm. Assign element type C3D8R and generate the mesh.

Job:
Create a job named Job-Modal-A, submit it for analysis, and wait for successful completion.

Visualization:
Review the first four mode shapes. Record the first natural frequency in Hz.

Save:
Save the model database to C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\Job-Modal-A.cae and ensure the output database is generated as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\Job-Modal-A.odb.
